أنتبه (form VIII)
# أَنْتَبِهُ (ʔantabihu) /ʔan.ta.bi.hu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# أُنْتَبَهُ (ʔuntabahu) /ʔun.ta.ba.hu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# أَنْتَبِهَ (ʔantabiha) /ʔan.ta.bi.ha/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# أُنْتَبَهَ (ʔuntabaha) /ʔun.ta.ba
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
